name: langsmith-otel
title: LangSmith over OpenTelemetry

origin.source: Real @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node + @opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-http (no shims): createOtelTraceHandler from @statelyai/agent/otel feeds a NodeTracerProvider, exported over OTLP/HTTP to LangSmith when LANGSMITH_API_KEY is set, and to an in-memory exporter otherwise; runs keyless with scripted executors and prints the finished span tree

comparison.purpose: Shipping a run to a vendor is one exporter config, not an adapter: @statelyai/agent/otel maps the versioned AgentTraceEvent stream onto GenAI-semconv spans, and the vendor is a URL plus headers on a stock OTLPTraceExporter. Braintrust, Langfuse, Honeycomb, or Grafana Tempo change those two fields and nothing else.
comparison.requires: A LangSmith account (LANGSMITH_API_KEY, optional LANGSMITH_PROJECT) only to upload spans; the keyless run exports to memory and prints the span tree. The LangSmith endpoint and header names follow the linked docs (checked 2026-08-01) but the live upload has not been executed against a real account.
